findings.title: Cached list navigation does not invalidate the active document request
findings.rationale: D-07 requires navigation to close the disclosure and abort or invalidate pending work. ListaNotas preserved disclosure/request ownership when browser navigation selected another cached query containing the same noteId.
findings.suggested_action: Invalidate document ownership and clear the disclosure on navigation/query-generation changes even when the note remains mounted, with a browser regression using warmed cache entries sharing a noteId.

findings.title: Escape loses keyboard focus while a document request is pending
findings.rationale: close(true) scheduled the busy-state release and immediately focused a still-disabled trigger, leaving document.activeElement on BODY after the trigger became enabled.
findings.suggested_action: Restore focus after the enabled trigger commits and add pending-request Escape coverage for abort and focus restoration.

overall_assessment: Two reproducible frontend lifecycle/accessibility defects remained within the approved scope; the backend and other reviewed boundaries were aligned.
recommended_path: Resolve both findings, refresh browser/lifecycle evidence, then repeat the independent final review.
